_note: Lore lessons a creature learns on first entering each biome, plus one line it may say. By Cosmic Emeth; all invented, Cory can change any.

glacier.lesson: Ice keeps old light inside. Cold can protect, not only hurt.
glacier.line: The ice is humming. It remembers the sun.

tundra_crystal_moss.lesson: Crystal moss sings when touched gently. Softness gets answers.
tundra_crystal_moss.line: I touched the moss and it sang back!

dark_forest.lesson: Not every shadow is danger. Some are just shade.
dark_forest.line: It's dark in here, but nobody's mean.

grass_plains.lesson: Grass grows where friends gather. Company makes the land greener.
grass_plains.line: The grass got taller when we played.

sunflower_ring.lesson: Sunflowers turn toward the light. Turning toward hope is a choice.
sunflower_ring.line: They all look at the sun. I'll try it.

heartwood_forest.lesson: Old trees grow slowly and never stop. Patience is a kind of growing.
heartwood_forest.line: This tree is older than the stars I know.

jelly_coast.lesson: The geysers pulse with the heartbeat. Everything here breathes together.
jelly_coast.line: The sea is breathing. In... out... rawr.

beach.lesson: Waves erase footprints. Playing is still worth it.
beach.line: The water took my pawprints. Again!

ember_fields.lesson: Fire makes glass from sand. Heat can make something beautiful.
ember_fields.line: Hot paws! But look, the sand turned shiny.

volcano.lesson: New land is born from the hottest places.
volcano.line: The mountain is making brand new ground.

paper_sea_marsh.lesson: The marsh whispers like turning pages. Every place has a story.

celestial_peaks.lesson: From high up, the whole world fits in one look. Distance gives perspective.
celestial_peaks.line: I can see everyone from up here.
